opus.problem: Saying the name means 'God with us' gives the word away. Most bakers know Immanuel = 'God with us', so this clue is not medium hard.
It rests on the same fact as clue 6, the phrase 'God is with us'. The clue only points to the word through that meaning, so it nearly repeats clue 6 and, like it, comes close to giving the word away.
